Boiler-and-pump device that made espresso a bar drink.

How Espresso machine connects

  • Item: Espresso — The espresso machine is what makes espresso a bar drink.
  • Topic: Barista — The barista's craft is organized around the espresso machine.

What is Espresso machine?

From Gaggia's postwar lever to modern rotary pumps, the espresso machine is the hardware of the Italian bar and the Starbucks-era café.

Key threads lead to Espresso and Barista.
